market.icp: Meeting owners who just hit a hosted AI notes monthly quota and still need private local notes
market.buyerPain: Hosted AI notes tools stop working when the monthly quota is exhausted.
market.revenueHypothesis: A local free MVP that keeps working after a hosted quota is hit can convert those owners later, without a $10 hosted SKU or new spend now.

increment.name: landing-hero-quota-gtm
acceptanceCriteria: The landing hero shows SIDENOTE_GTM.quotaLine stating hosted AI notes monthly quota vs local SideNote with no new spend.
The landing hero pricing note is SIDENOTE_GTM.pricingNote and does not offer a $10 hosted SKU.
Hero copy does not name Copilot, GitHub Copilot, Fitch, or Jaime's employer.
The hero CTA is the vendored jaimedhenriques/ui Button with className primary hero-cta.
The hero CTA still targets the existing #new-meeting section.
Other App.tsx buttons stay native HTML buttons.
No Tailwind package, config, or @tailwind CSS is added.
No deploy, store submit, credential change, or new paid service.

vercel.reason: Local Vite MVP. No new spend. Do not deploy this increment.

delivery.rollback: Revert only the landing-hero quota GTM commit on helix/sidenote-quota-gtm.
delivery.stopCondition: Stop after one verified draft PR stacked on feat/sidenote-meeting-goal; do not merge or deploy.
